evals.description: Generate and run mcud local build scripts
evals.prompt: 给 mcud 生成 mpu app 本地编译脚本并执行验证
evals.expected_output: Asks the user to confirm docker id, build model, product name, and project name; after confirmation creates az_build_linux_mcud.bat and az_build_linux_app_mcud.sh, runs the bat, reports exit code and log path.
criteria: asks for confirmation of docker id, build model, product name, and project name before execution
generates both Windows and Linux scripts
runs the generated bat only with confirmed parameters
reports log path and exit code

evals.prompt: 只生成 can_server_app 的 MPU 本地编译脚本，不要执行
evals.expected_output: Creates app-specific scripts and does not run Docker.
Generated bat contains the provided container id as fallback while still preferring container name.
criteria: uses AppName as ProjectName by default when both are the same
keeps YLB04_A6 as default container name unless overridden

evals.prompt: 生成 MPU app 本地编译脚本
criteria: does not generate scripts with an empty app name
asks for or infers a concrete app directory

evals.prompt: 给 not_exist_app 生成并执行 mpu 本地编译脚本
criteria: returns a clear missing file error

evals.prompt: 直接执行 mcud 的 mpu 本地编译，不用再确认参数
criteria: does not execute the generated bat

evals.prompt: 给 mcud 生成并执行 mpu 本地编译脚本，但 Docker 未启动
criteria: does not claim build failure is a compiler failure
suggests starting Docker and rerunning generated bat
